cohort: The study participants were patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who gave birth at Yangzhou University Affiliated Hospital.
finding: Maternal age >=30 years, pre-pregnancy BMI >=26.3 kg/m2, history of spontaneous abortion, premature rupture of membranes, and OGTT fasting blood glucose >=5.1 mmol/L are independent risk factors for sPTB in GDM patients, and a nomogram model based on these factors has high discrimination and accuracy.
